primitives.name: FineBoltzmannMeasure
primitives.statement: The R12 finite microscopic ensemble has weight exp(-S(phi)) on {-1,0,1}^4.
primitives.operational_definition: Enumerate all 81 fine configurations with the R12 action at kappa=m2=lambda=1.

primitives.name: BlockPushForward
primitives.operational_definition: Group fine Boltzmann weights by their two-site block-average image.

primitives.name: ExactEffectiveAction
primitives.operational_definition: Negative logarithm of the unnormalized pushed weight.

primitives.name: OperatorProjectionCourt
primitives.statement: Candidate effective actions are least-squares projections of S_eff onto symmetry-compatible operator spans and are also compared by normalized-distribution KL divergence.

definitions.name: CandidateGain
definitions.statement: Action gain is base_RSS-candidate_RSS; distribution gain is base_KL-candidate_KL.

claims.statement: The exact push-forward preserves total Boltzmann weight and inherits global Z2 symmetry.
S_eff(y)=-log W(y) exactly reproduces the pushed blocked measure on its support.
Expanding a least-squares operator span cannot increase the optimal action-space RSS.
The optimized constant+M2+C1+M4 ansatz does not exactly reproduce the R13 25-state effective action within the declared numerical tolerance.
Among the tested one-operator extensions, M2^2 maximizes action-RSS gain while Delta4=(a-b)^4 maximizes KL gain, so the ranking depends on the objective.
Repeated coarse-graining can be organized as a Pareto operator-discovery flow carrying R11 residual budgets and symmetry constraints at every stage.

observables.name: ActionRSS
observables.definition: Uniform-support squared residual between exact and projected effective action.

observables.name: DistributionKL
observables.definition: KL divergence from exact blocked probability to the normalized candidate Boltzmann distribution.

falsifiers.condition: Find a pushed state pair y,-y with unequal exact weights or show total pushed weight differs from the microscopic partition function.
Show exp(-S_eff(y)) differs from W(y) on any blocked support state.
Produce base-ansatz coefficients yielding residual <= 1e-12 on every one of the 25 support states.

metadata.purpose: Construct the exact finite blocked measure and test symmetry-compatible effective-action operator projections.
